AspirantUser.title: AspirantUser
AspirantUser.description: Registered WBP & KP aspirant profile with target exam, caste category, and performance summary.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the aspirant owner.

casteCategory.description: Registered caste/category for cut-off and PMT relaxations.

testsAttempted.description: Total number of mock tests attempted.

totalScoreAccumulated.description: Cumulative score across all attempted mock tests.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VaultQuestion.title: VaultQuestion
VaultQuestion.description: Structured exam question with subject, chapter, PYQ metadata, and Bengali explanation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created/synced the question.

chapter.description: Exact chapter name mapped to the chosen subject.

isPyq.description: Whether this question is a Previous Year Question (PYQ).

pyqExam.description: PYQ exam name when isPyq is true.

pyqYear.description: PYQ year (2005-2026) when isPyq is true.

questionBn.description: Question stem in Bengali (or English for English subject).

optionsBn.description: Array of 4 option strings [Option A, Option B, Option C, Option D].

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TestAttempt.title: TestAttempt
TestAttempt.description: Recorded mock test attempt by an aspirant.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the aspirant who took the test.

scoreObtained.description: Net marks scored after negative marking.

maxMarks.description: Total maximum marks of the test.

createdAt.description: Attempt completion timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted admin registry document keyed by admin UID.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual aspirant profiles isolated by userId.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Stores cloud-synced questions owned by userId or accessible by admin.

/test_attempts/{attemptId}.description: Stores immutable mock test attempt records isolated by userId.
